The following sections list features released in the past months, with links to related information.
(General availability) Computer use is now generally available, letting your agents automate web and desktop apps by controlling browsers and desktop applications on behalf of users.

(Production-ready preview) Use the new experience in Copilot Studio to build agents. The GitHub Copilot harness uses an enhanced orchestration runtime for improved response quality and reasoning, available alongside the standard harness.
(Preview) Run automated agent evaluations from a REST API using the Power Platform API to integrate evaluation into CI/CD and custom automation pipelines.

Add Dataverse tables as a knowledge source to ground your agent in your organization's Dataverse data, including (preview) unstructured reasoning over Multiline Text and File columns so your agent can find answers in notes, descriptions, and attached documents, not just structured fields.
Add Azure SQL tables as a knowledge source to ground your agent in structured data from your Azure SQL database or SQL Server, so it can answer questions directly from your business data.

claims.claim: The legacy planner is frozen and directs readers to the AI at Work roadmap, rather than providing a current 2026 release-wave inventory.
Planned month values, release-phase tags and page-modified dates are distinct from a released label and tenant availability.

Computer use can be GA in standard agents, preview as a standalone agent-flow tool, planned in the new harness, and withdrawn under a different roadmap ID without a contradiction about the entire product.
Roadmap IDs 562222 and 566998 retain the same title and month values but different statuses; the collected documents do not justify merging them or assigning each ID to a harness.

Launched roadmap item 569475 mentions Editor, but the current new sharing UI documentation describes viewing rights with alternative editor-role paths; verify required authoring operations separately.
A Dataverse selection test must cover Dataverse search, Microsoft authentication, data permissions, the 15-table limit and separately preview unstructured columns.
SQL source availability needs the connection identity, network path, selected table/view and published experience to work, not merely a visible menu item.
This article's local query is a manually verified snapshot, with explicit source links; it does not scrape cross-origin sources, refresh itself, or inspect customer environments.

limitations: The 12 roadmap IDs are unique and deliberately selected, not all Copilot Studio features; same-title records with distinct IDs are kept, so the ID count is not a count of independent capabilities.
All selected live roadmap records list Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant); this does not establish every region, language, license, tenant, or rollout group.

Microsoft Learn monthly headings are announcement periods, not exact deployment dates; collected Learn ms.date metadata is not a footer Last updated date or a feature release date. The footer date and updated_at were not collected.
No customer tenant, account, region rollout, authentication token, license entitlement, paid model or production service was inspected or invoked.
The roadmap's published removal policy makes disappearance ambiguous; the fetched feed still contains some Launched and Cancelled entries, so no retention period is inferred.
The migration blog redirect returned HTTP 403 and was not used for feature or availability claims; the migration facts come from the fetched planner banner and archive notices.
